**Test image:** Detached tomato leaf on gray surface. Yellow-green mottled patches on upper surface, no distinct necrotic spots, no fungal growth, no lesion margins, diffuse chlorosis interspersed with dark green areas.

**Key comparisons:**
- **Leaf_Mold** (CDDM_1006, CDDM_1036, CDDM_1057): All three show detached leaves on similar gray/neutral surfaces with diffuse yellow-green chlorosis on the upper surface, no distinct margins. CDDM_1057 is nearly identical in shape and pattern to the test image.
- **CMV**: Showed shoestring leaf distortion - not matching
- **TSWV**: Bronzing + distinct necrotic spots - not matching
- **Septoria**: Small dark spots - not matching
- **Early_Blight**: Dark concentric-ring lesions - not matching
- **Powdery_Mildew**: White powdery coating - not matching
- **Verticillium_Wilt**: Drooping/wilting, V-shaped lesions - not matching
- **Gray_Mold**: Brown necrotic margins - not matching
- All stem/pod classes: Wrong plant part

The test image most closely matches Leaf_Mold references - diffuse indistinct yellow chlorosis on upper leaf surface, consistent with the KB description: "brighter yellow with indistinct chlorosis on upper leaf surface."
